name: tr_poeltl
caption:
IF POELTL HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🌲 Snover: lives up on snowy mountains. From Vienna, the first Austrian ever drafted
🦴 Marowak: throws its bone like a boomerang. Traded for Kawhi, back with us in 2023
🧊 Avalugg: an ice body as hard as steel. 6 blocks and 30 points days after coming home
🥋 Hariyama: one slap can stop a train. 70.0% from the field last season
🟣 Swalot: no teeth, it swallows everything whole. 19 points and 11 rebounds at Milwaukee
🦖 Tyranitar: knocks down mountains to build its nest. Our big man, career-best 14.5 points a night in 2024-25

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Jakob Poeltl had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF POELTL HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Snover. It lives up on snowy mountains. From Vienna, we took him ninth, the first Austrian ever drafted.
beats.dlg: LIVES ON SNOWY MOUNTAINS.|PICK 9: FIRST AUSTRIAN!

beats.vo: Marowak. It throws its bone like a boomerang. We sent him to San Antonio for Kawhi. In twenty twenty-three, he came right back.
beats.dlg: ITS BONE IS A BOOMERANG.|SENT FOR KAWHI. CAME BACK!

beats.vo: Avalugg. Its ice body is as hard as steel. Days after coming home: six blocks and thirty points against Orlando.
beats.dlg: ICE BODY, HARD AS STEEL.|6 BLOCKS AND 30 POINTS!

beats.vo: Hariyama. One straight-arm slap can stop a train. Seventy percent from the field last season.
beats.dlg: ONE SLAP STOPS A TRAIN.|SHOT 70.0% LAST SEASON!

beats.vo: Swalot. No teeth. It swallows everything whole. Nineteen and eleven at Milwaukee this month.
beats.dlg: IT SWALLOWS EVERYTHING.|19 AND 11 AT MILWAUKEE!

beats.vo: And the ace. Tyranitar. It can knock down a mountain to build its nest. Our big man, a career-best fourteen point five a night in twenty twenty-four twenty-five.
beats.dlg: IT KNOCKS DOWN MOUNTAINS.|CAREER-BEST 14.5 A NIGHT!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Pöltl was born in Vienna; June 23, 2016 selected by Toronto with the ninth overall pick (#9, pick 9), the first Austrian drafted to the NBA; traded with DeRozan to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard in July 2018; traded back to the Raptors on February 9, 2023; February 14, 2023: 30 points, nine rebounds and 6 (six) blocks in a 133-123 win over the Orlando Magic
